notes: All 46 source and 54 target ids are partitioned exactly once across the 45 units; every head is a member of its array.

The single written *the* of *the east gate* goes to the present attributive article s014 rather than to the construct s011, per rule 47's clause that a present article takes the written *the* even where the head noun is a construct.
*at the door of the gate* is rule 29's arthrous-rectum case: two *the*s are written, so the construct s023 takes the supplied one and the article s024 takes the one standing before its own word.
קָדִימָה is read as host plus directive he sharing one English word under rule 32, not as a paragogic he under rule 32's first sentence.
The one waw of עֶשְׂרִים וַחֲמִשָּׁה stands between the same two numerals the ASV's single *and* joins, so rule 42 leaves nothing in surplus on either side.
